name: What are the risks of ignoring damaged window flashing?

mainEntity.name: What are the risks of ignoring damaged window flashing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ignoring damaged window flashing can lead to severe and costly problems for your home. The primary risk is water intrusion, which can cause wood rot in window frames, wall studs, and sheathing, compromising structural integrity. This moisture also creates an ideal environment for mold and mildew growth, posing health risks and requiring extensive remediation. Additionally, water damage can lead to warped flooring, damaged drywall and paint, and increased energy bills due to compromised insulation. Addressing flashing issues promptly protects your investment and prevents minor repairs from escalating into major renovations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ignoring damaged window flashing risks water intrusion, leading to wood rot, mold growth, structural damage, and increased energy bills. Prompt repair prevents costly extensive renovations.
